paper_name: 26_C.P. Lee, C.C. Chang, Y.Y. Chen, J.W. Yeh, and H.C. Shih. Corrosion Science, 50 (2008) 2053-2060.pdf

pdf.filename: 26_C.P. Lee, C.C. Chang, Y.Y. Chen, J.W. Yeh, and H.C. Shih. Corrosion Science, 50 (2008) 2053-2060.pdf

alloy.preparation: As-cast CrFe1.5MnNi0.5 made from Al, Cr, Fe, Mn and Ni granules above 99 wt% purity, with the stated nominal mole proportions. Arc melted at 500 A on water-cooled copper hearth; melting/casting at 0.01 atm after three argon purges, with repeated remelting/solidification for homogeneity. Ingots approximately 50 mm diameter × 20 mm thick. Cylinders electric-arc-line cut from bulk and cold mounted in epoxy with 0.5 cm² exposed; mechanically polished through 240–1200-grit SiC and cleaned in acetone and distilled water.
alloy.microstructure: FCC solid solution with alpha-FeCr phase identified in Figure 2.

test_solution.preparation: Deaerated by bubbling purified nitrogen before and throughout electrochemical testing; duration and pH unreported.
test_solution.solvent: Water (source explicitly calls these aqueous environments)

test_method.procedure_description: Specimen working electrode, Ag/AgCl reference in 3 M KCl and 4 cm² Pt-sheet counter; AUTOLAB PGSTAT30. Free corrosion for 30 min to quasi-stationary OCP, then cathodic polarization at −0.2 V for 300 s to reduce surface oxides. Potentiodynamic scan at 1 mV/s from reported −0.5 V to 1.5 V versus OCP; displayed potentials are on SHE scale. Numerical electrolyte temperature is not supplied. Separate cyclic tests use 10 mV/s, −0.75 to 0.95 V and reversal; those are not substituted for the registered potentiodynamic tests.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Sharp increase in anodic current indicating sustained localized breakdown of the passive film; the paper explicitly labels Table 3 values Epit. Chloride-free acid breakdown is also described as transpassive near oxygen evolution, retained as a scientific qualification.

experiments.result_note: Endpoint for the named alloy from a condition-specific two-endpoint statement. The Al0.3 outcome is only described as about equal to Al0.5 and is not assigned a number. Table 1 supplies bulk wt% chemistry; no normalization or missing balance is calculated. The source gives no numerical test temperature, so test_temperature remains null. Reference filling KCl is not a test solute.
